analysis.jiraIssueSummary: 3.1 FE - Catalog Import - Spectacle Lens Success/Failure Toast and Post-Import Visibility
requirementOrBugAnalysis: Story scope is FE behavior after user clicks Confirm on Spectacle Lens import confirmation popup: in-progress, success, and failure toast behavior plus post-import visibility in Catalog.
Success toast requirement: green toast with exact message "Spectacle Lens imported successfully", includes dismiss control (x), and follows existing Frame import toast position/styling/duration.
Failure toast requirement: red toast with exact message "Spectacle Lens catalog import failed.", includes dismiss control (x), and follows existing Frame import toast position/styling/duration.
Loading-state toast requirement: yellow in-progress toast while import is running, includes dismiss control (x), and follows Frame import toast pattern.
During import-in-progress, user cannot import new items: checkboxes and Select All are disabled until completion.
After successful import, imported Spectacle Lens records must be visible under Settings > Ordering > Catalog > Spectacle Lens.
In catalog import section after successful import, imported records are greyed out, non-selectable, and remain with checkbox selected.
When user filters/searches by Product Category = Spectacle Lens, imported records appear in Catalog tab results table.
Catalog table behavior for Spectacle Lens references GEM-35700; this story depends on that behavior being implemented/defined.

Description includes pricing/status/marketability/invoice rules that appear largely BE/data-rule oriented; FE verification should validate visible outcomes where exposed in UI, while rule computation likely depends on BE story GEM-35253.
missingInformation: No acceptance criteria with explicit toast duration value; only references existing Frame import pattern.
No explicit definition of what triggers failure state in FE (API error codes, partial import, timeout, validation errors).
No explicit requirement for behavior if user dismisses in-progress toast before completion.
No explicit requirement whether import action controls besides checkboxes/Select All (e.g., Confirm button, upload button) must be disabled during in-progress state.
No explicit statement on ordering/sorting position of newly imported records in Catalog table.
No explicit statement on visibility latency/refresh behavior (auto-refresh vs manual refresh required).
No explicit requirement for pluralization/count in toast content (single static message only).
No explicit requirement for handling partial success scenarios.
No explicit UI field(s) where Status=Active and Price/open price are displayed for verification.
Marketability and invoice rule reference says "described here" but linked source/details are not included.
ambiguities: In-progress toast text is not specified, only color/purpose/pattern.

Requirement says imported records in import section are greyed out and checkbox selected; unclear whether this applies immediately after success only or persistently for all previously imported items.
Unclear whether user can navigate away during in-progress import and whether disabled state persists across navigation/refresh.
Unclear expected behavior when multiple imports are initiated in sequence after first completion (toast stacking/queuing).
Unclear if failure should keep records selectable for retry in import section and with what checkbox state.
risks: FE/BE contract mismatch could show incorrect toast state (e.g., success shown on partial or failed backend processing).
Disabled-state race condition may allow duplicate import submissions if controls are not atomically disabled.
Incorrect category filter mapping may prevent newly imported Spectacle Lens from appearing in Catalog tab.
Styling/pattern drift risk if Frame import toast pattern changed and this feature does not inherit same component.
Greyed-out/non-selectable state could be applied to wrong rows if row identity mapping is unstable.
If catalog refresh is delayed, users may perceive import failure despite backend success.
dependencies: GEM-35253 (BE counterpart for success/failure toast triggers and post-import visibility data behavior).
GEM-35700 (Spectacle Lens Catalog tab table behavior reference).
Existing Frame import toast pattern implementation for position/styling/duration parity.
Catalog import API responses/states used by FE to determine in-progress/success/failure.
Potential downstream validation in GEM-38725 (Ordering Testing).
clarificationQuestions: What is the exact in-progress toast message text to validate?
What exact duration and auto-dismiss behavior should be used for each toast state, or should we inherit exact values from Frame import?
If user dismisses the in-progress toast manually, should it reappear, remain dismissed, or be replaced by final success/failure toast only?
Are there partial-success outcomes for mixed valid/invalid records? If yes, what toast color/message and row states are expected?
On failure, what should be the state of affected rows in import section (checkbox selected/unselected, selectable/non-selectable, greyed/not greyed)?
Should any additional import controls (e.g., confirm/import button) be disabled during in-progress, beyond checkboxes and Select All?
Is Catalog tab expected to update automatically after success, or is manual refresh/navigation required?
Where in UI should Status=Active and computed/open price be verified for imported Spectacle Lens records?
Please provide the missing marketability/invoice rule reference link or explicit acceptance criteria.
recommendedTestScenarios: Validate in-progress toast appears immediately after Confirm and matches yellow styling/pattern with dismiss control.
Validate import controls (checkboxes and Select All) are disabled during in-progress and re-enabled after completion where applicable.
Validate success toast exact text/color and dismiss control; confirm pattern parity with Frame import toast.
Validate failure toast exact text/color and dismiss control; confirm pattern parity with Frame import toast.
Validate successful imported records appear in Catalog > Spectacle Lens and in Product Category filter/search results.
Validate imported rows in catalog import section are greyed out, remain checked, and are non-selectable after success.
Validate behavior under backend failure/network error/timeout to ensure proper failure toast and no false visibility in Catalog.
Validate sequential imports: second import blocked during first in-progress and allowed after completion.
Validate UI state consistency on page refresh/navigation after successful import.
Validate integration alignment with GEM-35700 table behavior for Spectacle Lens display.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that in-progress import displays a yellow toast and disables import selection controls
preconditions: User is logged in with access to Settings > Ordering > Catalog import area.
At least one Spectacle Lens record is available and selectable for import.

steps.action: Select one or more Spectacle Lens records and click Confirm in the import confirmation popup.
Observe toast area immediately after confirmation.
steps.expected: A yellow in-progress toast is displayed and includes a dismiss control (x), matching Frame import toast placement/styling.

steps.action: Try to click row checkboxes and Select All while import is still running.
steps.expected: Checkboxes and Select All are disabled and cannot be changed.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that successful import displays the success toast with exact message
preconditions: Backend is configured to return successful import response.

steps.action: Import Spectacle Lens record(s) by confirming import.

steps.expected: Green toast appears with exact text: "Spectacle Lens imported successfully" and includes dismiss control (x).

steps.action: Compare toast location/style/dismiss behavior to existing Frame import toast.
steps.expected: Position, styling, and duration behavior match Frame import toast pattern.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that failed import displays the failure toast with exact message
preconditions: Backend or test environment can simulate import failure.

steps.action: Initiate import and force/trigger failure response.
steps.expected: Import request completes with failure state.
Red toast appears with exact text: "Spectacle Lens catalog import failed." and includes dismiss control (x).

steps.action: Compare toast location/style/dismiss behavior to existing Frame import toast.
steps.expected: Position, styling, and duration behavior match Frame import toast pattern.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that successfully imported records are visible in Spectacle Lens Catalog tab
preconditions: At least one Spectacle Lens record has just been imported successfully.

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Ordering > Catalog > Spectacle Lens.
steps.expected: Imported Spectacle Lens record(s) are present in the Catalog table.

steps.action: Apply Product Category filter = Spectacle Lens and/or search for imported item identifiers.
steps.expected: Imported records are returned in results table.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that imported rows become greyed out, checked, and non-selectable in import section after success
preconditions: A Spectacle Lens import has completed successfully.

steps.action: Return to the catalog import section list containing the imported rows.
steps.expected: Imported rows are displayed as greyed out.

steps.action: Inspect checkbox state for imported rows.
steps.expected: Checkboxes for imported rows remain selected.
Imported rows are not selectable (no state change allowed).

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that import controls are re-enabled after import completion
preconditions: Import in-progress state can be observed.

steps.action: Start an import and wait until final success or failure toast appears.
Attempt to use checkboxes and Select All on eligible non-imported rows.
steps.expected: Controls are enabled again for allowed rows after completion.

regressionConsiderations: Regression test Frame import toasts are unaffected (position/styling/duration and messaging).
Regression test other catalog import product types to ensure disabling logic during in-progress did not over-block unrelated workflows.
Regression test Catalog filters/search behavior for non-Spectacle categories.
Regression test row selection persistence and greyed-out rendering after page reload.
Regression test FE handling of API latency/timeouts to prevent stuck disabled controls.
